tex_content.html:
Corollary
[Commutator with the heat operator] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0247 1. ch13:13.27\group Curvature Derivative Estimates

If $T$ is a covariant $p$-tensor, then \[ abla ^k(\partial _t-\Delta )T-(\partial _t-\Delta ) abla ^kT \preccurlyeq 3n(p+1)\sum _{i=0}^k(i+k+4) rac{(k+1)!}{(i+2)!(k-i)!} abla ^i\Rm * abla ^{k-i}T. \]
Proof

\sketch ↗ lem:chow-ii-higher-nabla-laplacian-commutator ↗ lem:chow-ii-nabla-time-commutator Subtract the two commutator formulas and put their coefficients over the common denominator $(i+2)!(k-i)!$. Their sum is bounded by the displayed coefficient; the $i=0$ term is the leading Laplacian term.

□
